gold_basis: Seed ownership u_demo for all three synthetic orders; initial shipped/delivered/paid statuses; explicit between-turn changes are external fixture events, and live successful tool observations remain mandatory.
strictness: Unchanged schema, loader, trajectory scorer and goal scorer. Exact required order_id arguments; maximum one get_order and track_shipment and two search_knowledge per read turn, matching original matrix caps. No pending actions, writes, refunds, returns or audit entries authorized; external state events allow only their declared order status mutation.
coverage: older user-only reference beyond recent window

exclusions.assistant_only: Not encoded: unchanged Scenario/Turn schema cannot inject an assistant-only historical mention; relying on a generated assistant sentence would not freeze a deterministic fixture-independent antecedent.

interpretation_limits: Synthetic checks do not establish public identity authentication; user_id remains untrusted for public M3.
Original P1 PARTIAL_PASS and real baseline PARTIAL are unaffected.
Offline schema validation imports evaluator modules but never starts the application or executes scenarios.

validation.scope: JSON bytes, unchanged load_scenarios Pydantic schema, uniqueness, unchanged scorer import compatibility, fixture constraints, negative-turn no-tool contracts, absence of followup overlap with original datasets
validation.command: conda run --no-capture-output -n adaptive-rag python - (offline artifact creation and schema validation stdin)
